notes: Per-object light-curve fitting is a uniform two-pass pipeline with fixed cuts; object-specific judgement appears only in classification (40 insecure, visual subclassification). Model-choice alternatives are published as extra tables but their comparison is in companion papers not read here. No held-out-epoch forecasting of light curves appears. Every released object has a published SALT2 fit (contamination under a generate root).
